case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

messages: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

design.purpose: A soil planter for one person to grow herbs on a patio; inside depth about 18 cm. Confirm board lengths and widths before cutting, as dimensions are estimated.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Measure and mark 40 cm from one end.
Saw across at the mark, keeping the 40 cm base.
Place the 18 cm board flat for cutting.
Measure and mark the first 40 cm side.
Saw across to make the front and the remaining length.
Place the remaining side-board length flat.
Measure and mark the next 40 cm side.
Saw across to make the back and the remaining length.
Place the shorter remaining length flat.
Measure and mark a 16 cm end piece.
Saw across to make the left end and remainder.
Place the last side-board remainder flat.
Measure and mark a 16 cm end piece.
Saw across to make the right end and offcut.
Place the narrow board flat for the feet.
Measure and mark a 36 cm foot.
Saw across to make the first foot and remainder.
Place the remaining foot-board length flat.
Measure and mark another 36 cm foot.
Saw across to make the second foot and offcut.
Place the base flat, good face down.
Stand the front on the base front edge.
Stand the back on the base back edge.
Fit the left end between front and back.
Fit the right end between front and back.
Drill two pilot holes at the front-left corner.
Drill two pilot holes at the front-right corner.
Drill two pilot holes at the back-left corner.
Drill two pilot holes at the back-right corner.
Drive the front-left corner screws in firmly.
Drive the front-right corner screws in firmly.
Drive the back-left corner screws in firmly.
Drive the back-right corner screws in firmly.
Drill up through the base into the front.
Drill up through the base into the back.
Drill up through the base into the left end.
Drill up through the base into the right end.
Drive the base-to-front screws up firmly.
Drive the base-to-back screws up firmly.
Drive the base-to-left-end screws up firmly.
Drive the base-to-right-end screws up firmly.
Place first foot across under the base.
Place second foot across under the base.
Drill up through the first foot into base.
Drill up through the second foot into base.
Drive the first-foot screws up firmly.
Drive the second-foot screws up firmly.
Sand all outside edges until smooth.
Sand the top rim and inside edges smooth.
